description: Start uploading a LOCAL video or image file from the user's machine into Flask. VIDEO: creates the asset immediately (container_id + shareable url, live before any bytes move) with the file as its version (asset_id / version_id), or a new version of an existing asset with version_of, and returns a presigned upload URL; upload the bytes with the curl command from next_step, then call upload_file_complete(asset_id). Max 5GB. IMAGE (content_type image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp or image/gif, max 20MB): returns upload_url and image_url and creates NO asset yet; curl the bytes, then call upload_file_complete(image_url) with the folder_id / version_of / title you want - the asset is made there. folder_id is OPTIONAL: omit it to upload to the team's top level (root). On the free plan new assets are limited (web and agents together); a new version via version_of is always free. When the team runs out of free assets the upload is refused with that message: tell the user to upgrade at https://flask.do/plan to continue immediately. If the curl upload fails, retry the same curl to the same URL; calling upload_file_start again creates (and counts) another asset. You still need edit access on the folder if one is given.

content_type.description: MIME type of the file (defaults to video/mp4). image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp or image/gif uploads an image.

file_size.description: Exact size of the local file in bytes (e.g. from `stat -f%z <file>` on macOS or `stat -c%s <file>` on Linux)

folder_id.description: Optional folder to upload into (you must have edit access - check with permission_get if unsure). Omit to upload to the team's top level (root). For an image, pass it to upload_file_complete instead.

title.description: Title for the new asset (defaults to "Untitled Video"). For an image, pass it to upload_file_complete instead.

version_of.description: Upload as a NEW VERSION of an existing asset instead of creating a separate asset. Accepts the id of the asset (its container id, what contents/search return), or of any of its versions. The new upload becomes the current version; the asset's url then shows it. folder_id is ignored when version_of is given.

name: upload_file_start
title: Start local file upload
